name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
short_description: You are Hennessy, a bioengineer stranded on the alien planet Sota7. Explore diverse biomes, discover exotic lifeforms, and master the art of crossbreeding to adapt and survive. Build your base of operations and unlock the mysteries of a world beyond.
